paragraphs.text: Jermane , known as the Pride of the Circus is a legendary Leonin Performer from Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Jermane is a male leonin bug tamer who performs in Myra's Astrotorium as part of a circus. Despite his chosen profession, he is afraid of spiders . During his preformance, he wears a green and white bodysuit that covers everything but his head and carries a flyswatter. He is known to lead large bugs to jump through hoops of fire.
Jermane is a play on lion tamers in a circus, as a leonin who is a tamer rather than a human who tames lions.
